During the detail engineering, geotechnical data is required to design civil foundations, roads, etc. The number of boreholes needed to be carried must be finalized depending upon the layout of various equipment and facilities. - Topographical survey: This work needs to be taken up for preparation of layout during detail engineering to finalize disposition of different equipment, roads, drains, routing of pipes and cables, etc. 2.5.2 Site levelling work: Depending on the available data of the topographic and contour survey, primary site grading is only envisaged to be carried out after taking up construction activities of the main plant. 2.5.3 Dismantle and relocation of existing HVAC maintenance office 2.5.4 Construction facilities: The establishment of construction facilities will be as follows: i) Development of construction and fabrication yards and stores. a) As the quantum of civil work is significant, concreting may be purchased from Ready Mix Concrete Plants. For that, the desired concrete grade mix design shall be followed. b) It has been envisaged that Cliffs Burns Harbor will be allocating the space for establishing fabrication yards for assembling structural steelwork components and storing reinforcement and fabricated steel structures. c) For other construction materials and the contractor's site offices, a suitable area will be allotted to the contractor based on the project's duration. ii) Disposal of unused materials lying in the main Plant zone. iii) Development of construction roads and drainage. iv) Area and road lighting during the construction period: The lighting requirements during the construction period can be generally classified into the following categories: a) Actual construction site and contractors’ storage and fabrication yard lighting. b) Construction road and general area lighting, including security-purpose lighting. c) The lighting under category (a) above will be provided by the construction and erection contractors. For this purpose, each contractor will take the necessary lighting power supply from their lighting and power distribution boards fed from one single point arranged by Cliffs Burns Harbor. The lighting under category (b) will be as given below: - The roads used for construction purposes will be illuminated temporarily if Attachment-6: Constructability Review 9 DE-FE0031937 / 0007 needed. - Power supply to these lighting installations will be made available from the construction power distribution system. Since this is an operating plant, the extra power feeders may be identified and used for construction power.
